This editorial illustration features a stylized, round-bodied man in a light-blue collared shirt and tan pants, running towards the viewer on a red athletics track. He holds a large, white rectangular box with a grey rectangle on its front above his head with both hands. His facial expression includes squinted eyes and a wide grin. He has dark hair and a double chin. He is crossing a yellow finish line tape, which stretches across the lower third of the image.

The track is red with white painted lane lines and is bordered by a green field. Numerous white, square pieces of paper flutter through the air around the figure. In the background, the lower leg and foot of another person are visible, wearing black pants and blue shoes.

Tim Anies Baswedan dan Ganjar Pranowo mengupayakan pengajuan hak angket DPR soal kecurangan.
